title: Warm-up 2: Again
text: Peggy came out on the correct side once. A cheater guessing the side in advance would manage that half the time.
held: Twenty-one rounds in a row: luck is no longer a serious explanation.

cards.label: Run it twenty more times, with a new random side each time
Accept: she got it right
cards.why: One round is a coin toss. Each extra round halves a cheater's chances; one round barely dents them.

fields.label: chance a cheater passes one round

cards.label: Ask for the word as well, to be certain
cards.why: Asking for the secret undoes the whole exercise. The proof already makes cheating wildly unlikely.
